_purpose: Safety-phrase mapping: 8 HKDF output bytes → uint64 (big-endian) → three base-1296 digits, most-significant first → wordlist indices → words. End-to-end derivations from key material live in pairing-handshake.json.

wordlist.source: EFF short wordlist 2.0 (dice indices stripped); one global wordlist, rendered identically in all locales

mapping: n = uint64 big-endian from the 8 bytes; word0 = (n ÷ 1296²) mod 1296, word1 = (n ÷ 1296) mod 1296, word2 = n mod 1296; rendered lowercase in derivation order

cases.name: n-1295
cases.note: Last index of the least-significant digit.

cases.name: max-in-range
cases.note: n = 1296^3 - 1 → [1295,1295,1295] → the last word three times.

cases.name: wraps-word0
cases.note: n = 1296^3: word0 = (n ÷ 1296²) mod 1296 = 0 — the modulo on the most-significant digit matters because n is a full uint64.

cases.name: max-uint64
cases.note: n = 2^64 - 1, the largest 8-byte value; exercises the modulo path on all three digits.

cases.name: arbitrary
cases.note: An arbitrary fixed value (first 8 bytes of SHA-256("nimna/test-vectors/v1/phrase/arbitrary-1")).
